chunks.text: FEBS IIT Bhubaneswar Data Science Induction Program Project: Salary Prediction Prepared by: Saarthak Tiwari Head of Data Science, Society of Finance, Economics and Business (FEBS)

1 Problem Statement Your objective is to build an end-to-end Machine Learning pipeline that predicts an employee’s salary based on their demographic and professional background. You will extract the data, explore it visually, preprocess it for machine learning, and apply a Linear Regression model to find the solution. Ensure you evaluate and check the final accuracy of the model to prove its effectiveness. 2 Dataset Overview You will use theSalary Prediction Dataset. It maps various professional and demo- graphic attributes to compensation. The dataset contains the following columns: •Age: The age of the employee in years. •Gender: The gender of the employee (e.g., Male, Female). •Education Level: The highest degree earned (e.g., High School, Bachelor’s, Mas- ter’s, PhD). •Job Title: The specific professional role of the employee. •Years of Experience: The total working experience in years. •Salary (TARGET): The annual salary of the employee. 3 Data Extraction & Setup 1. Open a newGoogle Colabnotebook. 2. Go to Kaggle.com and search for theSalary Prediction Dataset. 3. Download the dataset to your local machine. 4. Upload the dataset into your Google Colab environment to begin your analysis.
